definitions: The ability for employees to perform their job duties from any location, rather than being restricted to a traditional office setting.
A flexible work model where an individual is not tied to a specific physical workplace and can complete tasks remotely from various places.
examples: Our company has embraced a 'work from anywhere' policy.
Many startups offer 'work from anywhere' as a perk.
The 'work from anywhere' trend gained popularity during the pandemic.
